# It All Started When When...

The Johns Hopkins Graduate Consulting Club 2024 case competition presented a real-world challenge: develop a go-to-market strategy for Hibiscus Health's breakthrough facial scanning technology. While the startup had successfully created AI-powered technology to detect early signs of metabolic conditions like pre-diabetes and hypertension through non-invasive blood flow analysis, they faced critical strategic challenges: unclear market positioning in a crowded digital health landscape, the need for a sustainable business model demonstrating clear value to multiple stakeholders, and uncertainty about how to expand their single-application technology into a broader platform. The challenge required identifying new clinical applications while addressing regulatory complexities and building sustainable competitive advantages.

# My Role

-   Conducted competitive analysis across facial scanning platforms, identifying key market differentiators and positioning Hibiscus Health's expansion into oral health biomarker detection as a first-to-market opportunity.

-   Setup dual-pathway technology enhancement leveraging PPG signal analysis and CNN imaging to create "smile scanning" capability, establishing the scientific linkage between periodontal disease and metabolic conditions.

-   Designed subscription-based "Smile & Subscribe" model with tiered pricing and partnership revenue streams, integrating with established platforms like Omada, Vida, and Cigna for comprehensive care coordination.

-   Developed tiered pricing structure with clear value propositions for each segment, projecting sustainable unit economics and 5-year financial projections

-   Created ecosystem strategy connecting patients to established platforms (Omada, Vida, Cigna) for care coordination and outcome optimization

# Results

-   Hibiscus Health [adopted core recommendations from the winning strategy](https://hibiscushealth.com/#how-it-works), validating the practical applicability of the proposed product strategy and business model

-   First-place victory at Johns Hopkins Graduate Consulting Club 2024 Annual Case Competition

-   \$1.2 billion projected cumulative healthcare savings over 5 years through preventative screening interventions

-   Projected 90% reduction in preventable periodontal cases targeting 32.8 million prediabetic adults aged 18-44

-   Competitive differentiation through first-to-market oral health integration in facial scanning technology, creating sustainable IP-protected market position

-   \$1.65 million funding requirement identified with sustainable 5% revenue capture model from healthcare savings
